title: A Satellite Imagery Dataset for Long-Term Sustainable Development in United States Cities
reasoning: The paper focuses on monitoring Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) using satellite imagery and other data, addressing socio-economic and environmental aspects like poverty, health, education, and urban development. While some SDGs (e.g., reduced inequalities) touch upon social justice, the paper measures quantitative indicators and outcomes related to these goals, rather than evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, spiritual traditions, theology, epistemology, hermeneutics, morals, or ethics as conceptual frameworks or belief systems.
